About Me

I'm Rukayya — a 400-level Civil Engineering student at Ahmadu Bello University, and a data analyst in the making. Engineering has been the goal since I can remember; data analytics found me while I was looking for a second skill, and it stuck. Since then I've worked through SQL, Power BI, and Looker Studio projects on real datasets, and I lead as Treasurer for APWEN ABU Zaria. Long-term, I'm building toward three things: becoming a strong structural design engineer, an expert data analyst working with major companies, and eventually an international speaker.

Projects

Logistics Operations Analysis

A logistics company's data was spread across multiple tables — orders, shipments, customers, inventory — with no clear picture of what was actually happening operationally. I queried the dataset in SQL, analyzed patterns in Python, and planned out a Power BI dashboard to visualize the findings, then packaged everything into a professional business intelligence report a decision-maker could actually act on.

View Project →

TradeZone E-Commerce Analysis

Raw e-commerce data is rarely usable straight out of the box — this dataset needed real cleaning before it could answer anything. I cleaned it, wrote eight SQL queries targeting real business questions (top products, customer behavior, sales trends), and summarized the findings in an analyst memo written for a non-technical reader.

View Project →

Video Game Sales Analysis

My first real data project — and the one that got me hooked. I cleaned and charted video game sales data in Excel, then turned the findings into a Canva presentation. It's simple compared to what I build now, but it's the project that proved to me I could actually do this.
